name: Form Field VLM Demo
description: Detect and understand fields in a form page

paragraphs: Public server-side demo for nutrientdocs/form-field-vlm. The commercial VLM is loaded from the private nutrientdocs/form-field-vlm-private repository using the Space's HFTOKEN secret; weights are never included in this Space.

The demo runs on Hugging Face ZeroGPU using Transformers with xgrammar-constrained JSON decoding. vLLM is reserved for persistent-GPU production deployments because its CUDA engine must remain resident. Nine named example forms cover government, insurance, employment, medical, financial, aviation, and multilingual layouts. Selecting an example fills the image input; inference starts only when Detect fields is pressed. The benchmark examples derive from CommonForms, CC-BY-4.0.

The hybrid path uses FF-DETR / CommonForms by jbarrow, Apache-2.0. The configured detector artifact is a Transformers-format conversion of the upstream model. FF-DETR contributes object detection and box localization only. It does not provide labels, fine field types, values, or radio-group links; those outputs come from the Nutrient VLM.
